fields.title: Doctor record
fields.description: One record per doctor. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). recordType discriminates: DOCTOR_CARD (specialty listing row), DOCTOR_PROFILE (full doctor page), SPECIALTY and CITY (reference mode).

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The listing scope or doctor URL that produced this record.

name.title: Name
name.description: Doctor's name with title as published, e.g. "dr. Rifan Fauzie, Sp.A (K)".

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: Doctor slug, or the specialty / city slug in reference mode.

specialty.title: Specialty
specialty.description: Specialty as published (listing rows give the Indonesian sub-specialty, profiles give the schema.org term).

specialtyLabel.title: Specialty label
specialtyLabel.description: Profile records -- the Indonesian sub-specialty label.

hospitals.title: All hospitals
hospitals.description: Every hospital the doctor practises at, with address (profiles often list several).

offers.title: Offers
offers.description: Consultation offers with price and currency, when the page lists more than one.

addresses.title: Practice addresses
addresses.description: Full postal addresses with locality and region.

consultationPrice.title: Consultation price
consultationPrice.description: Consultation fee as a plain number.

priceCurrency.title: Currency
priceCurrency.description: Currency of the consultation fee, e.g. IDR.

rating.title: Rating
rating.description: Patient satisfaction, published as a percentage string, e.g. "98%".

nextSchedule.title: Next schedule
nextSchedule.description: Next availability as published, e.g. "Tersedia Hari Ini" or "Jadwal Berikutnya : Besok, 16.00 Siang".

listName.title: List name
listName.description: Listing rows -- the specialty list the row came from.

listingUrl.title: Listing URL
listingUrl.description: Reference records -- the listing page for that specialty / city.

doctorsOnFirstPage.title: Doctors on first page
doctorsOnFirstPage.description: Reference records -- how many doctors the specialty's first page returned when verified.

_listingScope.title: Listing scope
_listingScope.description: Listing rows -- which specialty/city produced the row.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failures (not_found, not_a_profile, blocked_or_transient).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across listing and profile records.
